description: Sensitivity of FBN1/FBN2/DMD to filtering choices, and per-sample CPM gradient across the three DMD replicates
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Per-sample library-size CPM from the locked count matrix (printed by the sensitivity run).
cpm = pd.DataFrame({
 "GSM9042255":[333.50,133.63,4.15,319.80,5.05,33.78],
 "GSM9042256":[383.50,155.70,4.74,348.70,5.68,37.48],
 "GSM9042257":[335.78,133.92,4.87,329.34,4.47,31.66],
 "GSM9042258":[191.15,148.89,3.86,341.70,3.50,56.91],
 "GSM9042259":[159.01,106.12,3.65,303.87,2.75,50.99],
 "GSM9042260":[100.74, 70.01,2.50,237.33,2.93,38.05]},
 index=["FBN1","FBN2","DMD","ATP2A2","LTBP4","LTBP1"])
grp = ["healthy"]*3+["DMD"]*3

# FBN2 / FBN1 / DMD log2FC under five pipeline variants (in-memory sensitivity, primary = A)
var = ["A count>=10\nin >=3 (locked)","B CPM>1\nin >=3","C count>=5\nin >=2","D any\nnonzero","E locked +\nindep. filter"]
fbn2 = [-0.358,-0.361,-0.360,-0.362,-0.358]; fbn2q=[0.1106,0.1150,0.1240,0.6639,0.1106]
fbn1 = [-1.200,-1.203,-1.202,-1.204,-1.200]
dmdg = [-0.431,-0.434,-0.433,-0.435,-0.431]

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(13, 5.2), gridspec_kw={"width_ratios":[1.15,1]})

ax = axes[0]
x = np.arange(len(var)); w = 0.26
ax.bar(x-w, fbn1, w, color="#2b6cb0", label="FBN1")
ax.bar(x,   fbn2, w, color="#63b3ed", label="FBN2")
ax.bar(x+w, dmdg, w, color="#718096", label="DMD")
ax.axhline(-1.2, color="red", ls="--", lw=1.2)
ax.axhline(-0.9, color="darkorange", ls="--", lw=1.2)
ax.text(4.45,-1.19,"published FBN1 -1.2",color="red",fontsize=8,ha="right",va="bottom")
ax.text(4.45,-0.89,"published FBN2 -0.9",color="darkorange",fontsize=8,ha="right",va="bottom")
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(var, fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel("log2 fold change, DMD vs healthy")
ax.set_title("Filter and independent-filtering sensitivity\nFBN1 lands on -1.20 and FBN2 on -0.36 in every variant", fontsize=10)
ax.axhline(0,color="black",lw=0.8); ax.legend(fontsize=9)

ax = axes[1]
for i, g in enumerate(["FBN1","FBN2","ATP2A2","LTBP1","LTBP4","DMD"]):
    v = cpm.loc[g].to_numpy(); v = v/v[:3].mean()
    ax.plot(range(6), v, marker="o", label=g)
ax.axvspan(-0.3,2.3, color="#edf2f7"); ax.axvspan(2.7,5.3, color="#fffaf0")
ax.set_xticks(range(6)); ax.set_xticklabels(["WT1","WT2","WT3","DMD1","DMD2","DMD3"])
ax.set_ylabel("CPM, scaled to the healthy mean")
ax.set_title("Per-sample CPM: the three DMD replicates fall in a\nmonotone DMD1 > DMD2 > DMD3 gradient for most target genes", fontsize=10)
ax.axhline(1.0, color="black", lw=0.8, ls=":"); ax.legend(fontsize=8, ncol=2)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

print("FBN2 range across 5 pipeline variants: %.3f to %.3f log2; never below -0.37, published value -0.9" % (max(fbn2), min(fbn2)))
print("FBN2 q-value range: %.4f to %.4f; not significant in any variant" % (min(fbn2q), max(fbn2q)))
